en: A vintage, colorized street scene showing a wide boulevard flanked by multi-story buildings with early 20th-century architecture. There are people walking and a few horse-drawn carriages or early motor vehicles on the road. Trees line the street, and the center features a green median. The postcard has text at the top identifying the location and street, with additional signage visible on the buildings.
